lines.text: नमस्ते!
নমস্কার!
வணக்கம்!
કેમ છો!
నమస్కారం!
नमस्कार!
ਸਤ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਕਾਲ!
ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ!

India speaks in hundreds of languages. For years, editing software understood just one.
Not anymore. Here's an empty timeline. Watch six languages edit one video.
घाट वाला शॉट डालो, और शुरू के दो सेकंड काट दो।
lines.en: Add the ghat shot, and cut the first two seconds.

lines.text: ট্রামের শটটা দাও, আর মিউজিকের বিটে বিটে কাট করো।
lines.en: Add the tram shot, and cut on every beat.

lines.text: लोकलचा शॉट टाका, आणि थोडा फास्ट करा.
lines.en: Add the local train shot, and speed it up a little.

lines.text: చార్మినార్ షాట్ పెట్టండి, కలర్ కొంచెం వార్మ్ చేయండి.
lines.en: Add the Charminar shot, and make the colour a little warmer.

lines.text: மெரினா ஷாட் போடுங்க, கேப்ஷன்ஸ் கொஞ்சம் பெருசா பண்ணுங்க.
lines.en: Add the Marina shot, and make the captions bigger.

lines.text: પતંગનો શોટ મૂકો, ને સબટાઇટલ બધી ભાષામાં આપો.
lines.en: Add the kite shot, and give subtitles in every language.

lines.text: Six languages. One video. Not a single clip dragged. That's vibe editing.
अब edit करो, अपनी भाषा में।
lines.en: Now edit, in your own language.
